assessment.reason: Current page says C is central and its scalar in a representation is the central charge. The repaired actual def-virasoro-algebra instead defines central charge c only if C acts as c idV and explicitly warns that centrality alone does not force scalar action. Independently, in the left regular U(Vir) representation, left multiplication by C commutes with all Vir generators, but cannot equal cI: acting on1 would give C=c1, contradicting the independent PBW monomials1 andC for the supplied countable ordered Vir basis. The general supplied-basis PBW theorem thm-poincare-birkhoff-witt applies; the finite-dimensional PBW item is not used for this argument.
assessment.scope: Only the conditional wording of the central-charge clause changes. The Virasoro bracket, restricted-module hypotheses, all-complex-level noncritical Sugawara theorem and central-charge formula stay unchanged.
